tools.name: contract-security_contract-bytecode-compare
tools.description: Compare two caller-supplied EVM bytecodes. mode exact compares every byte. An omitted mode is exact. mode normalized masks only the supplied immutable ranges and a trailing Solidity CBOR metadata suffix when bytecodeKind is not creation and that suffix is present on both bytecodes. comparison_status

tools.name: contract-security_bytecode-structure-diff
tools.description: Decode two caller-supplied EVM bytecodes, or two instruction lists, into opcodes and compare the instruction sequence. Similarity ignores PUSH immediates.
